experiments.hypothesis: Recursive separators preserve more complete paragraph/clause boundaries than token fixed windows at equivalent 512-token target.
controlled_variables: same retrieval configuration if later enabled
metrics: complete-clause preservation only with verified references
experiments.limitation: Cannot claim retrieval quality without verified query/evidence annotations.
experiments.cost_and_complexity: Each local variant runs current-sized corpus chunking only; retrieval embedding cost remains 0 until a separately approved retrieval experiment. Complexity: two chunking passes per document; boundary comparison requires verified references.
experiments.failure_analysis: Not executed: this delivery stops before alternative algorithms. Failure analysis is N/A until results exist.

experiments.hypothesis: Chunk target size changes boundary preservation, context granularity, and token/index cost.
experiments.limitation: A0 is 1800 characters and has no preassigned equivalent token target.
experiments.cost_and_complexity: Six local variants (3 sizes x 2 algorithms); estimated chunk and future embedding-token totals must be measured, not inferred. Complexity is approximately linear in input text plus current block-span scans.
experiments.failure_analysis: Not executed: this delivery stops before alternative algorithms.

experiments.hypothesis: Overlap can reduce evidence fragmentation at increasing duplication and embedding/context cost.
experiments.limitation: No vector index/API usage in this offline step.
experiments.cost_and_complexity: Four local variants; expected embedding-token/index cost rises with overlap, but exact increase must be measured. Complexity increases with emitted chunk count.
experiments.failure_analysis: Not executed: this delivery stops before alternative algorithms.

experiments.hypothesis: Validated sentence packing reduces sentence-boundary cuts without unacceptable size inflation.
experiments.limitation: Clause protection is a separate variant; regex diagnostics are not accuracy.
experiments.cost_and_complexity: Local boundary segmentation; no API usage. Requires a curated Mongolian edge-case fixture and manual boundary labels.
experiments.failure_analysis: Not executed: sentence algorithm is absent and remains outside this implementation.

experiments.hypothesis: Available block kind, heading string, and page fences may improve structure preservation over token fixed windows.
controlled_variables: do not infer heading levels/list hierarchy/cell relationships
experiments.limitation: Parser loses heading hierarchy, automatic numbering, merged-cell topology and DOCX page locations.
experiments.cost_and_complexity: Local metadata-aware chunking; no API usage. Potential cost is boundary overflow/fallback and larger chunks. Only present parser metadata may be used.
experiments.failure_analysis: Not executed: parser structure losses limit available signals.
